sections.A: Yeh sar dard gardan se aata hai, aksar upar ki joints (C0 se C3) se. Gardan aur chehre ki nerves dimagh ke ek hi hisse mein milti hain, is liye gardan ka dard sar mein mehsoos hota hai.
sections.B: Aam taur par ek taraf ka dard jo gardan ke peeche se shuru ho kar aage phailta hai, gardan hilane ya der tak ek posture mein rehne se barhta hai, aur gardan ka ghoomna kam hota hai.
sections.C: Sawaal se pata karein ke dard kahan se shuru hota hai, kya gardan ki movement se aata hai, aur kya migraine (matli, roshni se takleef, aura) ya tension headache ke nishan hain.
sections.D: BP aur neuro screen, gardan ki movement, upar ki joints dabane par wahi sar dard aana, flexion-rotation test aur gehri gardan muscles ki taaqat dekhein.
sections.E: Flexion-rotation test mein gardan poori jhuka kar ghumate hain. Ek taraf ka ghoomna saaf kam ho to C1-C2 ki rukawat ka ishara hai, lekin yeh akela diagnosis nahi.
sections.F: Migraine, tension headache, cluster headache, occipital neuralgia aur jabre ke masle isi jaise lag sakte hain. Table mein har ek ka farq hai.
sections.G: Achanak zindagi ka sab se bura sar dard, bukhar aur akdi gardan, chakkar aur double vision, ya 50 saal ke baad naya sar dard: yeh emergency ya urgent hain. Treatment rokein aur refer karein.
sections.H: Pehle red flags. Phir agar ek taraf ka gardan se shuru hone wala dard hai, gardan ki movement se aata hai, aur flexion-rotation kam hai, to working diagnosis cervicogenic headache.
sections.I: C1-C2 SNAG, upar ki gardan ki halki mobilisation aur thoracic mobilisation. Inhein exercise ke saath milayein, akele nahi.
sections.J: Chin tuck, scapular retraction, upper trapezius aur suboccipital stretch, aur posture ki endurance. Halka dard jo theek ho jaye chalega; exercise mein sar dard barhe ya chakkar aaye to ruk jayein.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS sirf aaraam ke liye. Ultrasound, laser aur collar aam taur par recommend nahi.
sections.L: Pehli visit par samjhayein, phir triggers kam karein, halki movement aur manual therapy, phir endurance aur kaam ka posture, aakhir mein khud sambhalna.
sections.M: Har visit par sar dard ke din, shiddat, flexion-rotation range aur disability score likhein. 4 se 6 hafte mein farq na ho to plan dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 35 saal ke office worker ko computer ke baad right taraf sar dard hota hai. Khud socho kaun se findings diagnosis batate hain, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, exercise aur saath mein manual therapy. Red flags hon to pehle refer.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
